comments.author: Brin
comments.body_html:
[BSG took the MAWL from SPT]

Bit of a tangent, but I don’t think that’s actually true.

BSG was teasing the MAWL at least as far back as September of 2022.

Dueleus’s MAWL mod, which released here in May of 2023, used the MAWL asset from elsewhere (not sure where), and just applied it as a skin over a cloned DBAL-PL.

BSG finally added the MAWL into the base game with the 13.5 wipe in August of 2023.

That looks like parallel dev to me, with SPT modders releasing sooner.

comments.author: Brin
comments.body_html:
I’ve been running Loot Radius just fine with 3.9.8 plus Fika 9.8995.14684–is it just the newer version of Fika that breaks things?

Also, the issue with loot radius is that it doesn’t really let you grab stuff that’s buried in objects due to the decisions made by the developer. The only exception to that is stuff directly below each of your character’s feet.

Your change to allow us to manually grab stuff that’s fallen inside other objects is great for those circumstances where we *can’t* get our character model’s feet close enough to the object.

comments.author: Brin
comments.body_html:
For loose loot, it’s pretty clear that its a bug–the loot spawns in, and for whatever reason it falls through whatever object it was supposed to spawn on top of, and eventually collides with something lower, which often leaves stuff in places you can’t get to it.

If you’re ever able to watch 2-3 people in the same FIKA raid check the same places (e.g. Black room on Labs) the inaccessible items will be slightly different for each of them.
